existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increased LH is the same direction and endpoint as the existing 'Increased, Leutinizing hormone (LH)' (spelling variant), alongside the pituitary-specific form.
Increased endometrial adenocarcinomas is the same tumor process in a different tissue context.
Increased papillomas/carcinomas in squamous cells is a tumor increase in a distinct tissue context.
Necrosis in terminal bronchiolar cells is a cell-injury/cytotoxicity event in a specific cell context, comparable to club-cell cytotoxicity.
Decreased aromatase mRNA is a reduction in aromatase expression, related to general aromatase inhibition but with a different specificity.

new_groups.rationale: Both concern HIF-1 (heterodimer level vs alpha transcription), distinct processes for the same object.
Both concern pyruvate dehydrogenase regulation (PDH induction vs inhibition of its kinase PDK), distinct processes.
Both concern NE receptors, with binding of NE decreased vs antagonism of the receptor.
